name: Hang Nadim
bio: Hang Nadim carries requests on the royal household’s business. A berth inquiry is an errand, not an order from a siege admiral.
notes: fact: Brown depicts him as an agent and places his appointment as laksamana in the exile sequence (Brown chs. XVIII–XIX, pp. 139–148; ch. XXIII, p. 171)
gameplay: Port errands are invented; do not identify him as the commander of the 1511 fleet (people-factions.md §2)
